translationRepairs: By precedent, the Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs did not personally decide major state matters; all lawsuits were handled by the yilibi alone.
By precedent, the Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs never personally decided matters that were not major affairs of state; all lawsuits were handled by the yilibi alone.

非國家重務，未嘗親決 means that for affairs that were not major state matters the commissioner never decided them personally; the original reverses 非 and contradicts s0127, where later commissioners first began hearing lawsuits themselves.
By precedent, the Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs did not personally decide state weighty affairs; all lawsuits were presided over only by the yilibi.
By precedent, the Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs never personally decided affairs that were not weighty state matters; all lawsuits were presided over only by the yilibi.
The same 非 scopes the class left undecided: affairs that were not weighty state matters; the proposed literal restores that negation without changing the rest of the sentence.
